## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-13:

- Added trigger and frequency, inputs, outputs and tools per step, a controls section for money, access and data, and a gaps list that feeds process improvement.
- Replaced the upstream tip to name people with roles, to keep personal details out of shared documents.
- Added a rule never to put credentials in an SOP.
- Removed the connector section (knowledge base, project tracker), publishing to a wiki, task creation, the slash-command usage block and the reference to CONNECTORS.md.
- Added a draft status pending owner approval and a handoff section.
- Moved the layout into `references/sop-template.md`.
